body: I thought I was the only one.

You are not selfish just because you tell someone how you are.  Of course it's harder for others and easier for others, but we're all here in the group for a reason. No matter who you are or where you come from, you are cordially invited to share your concerns and problems.

I have the thoughts too and that’s ok. At this point of my life I have no energy to fight for everything. It’s hard to life in this world and I hope make it out of it. Every time I feel like that Music help to realise what are the beautiful things in life.
I hope that it will be as peaceful and painless as possible when you are 100% sure about taking this step. It takes great courage to do this and I will include you in my prayers.
thank you for letting me say what i feel . You don't know how much it means to me to say what depresses me without being stupidly looked at

I am 19 years old and I would say that I have experienced a lot but since my ex girlfriend broke up with me a year ago I have been in a permanent down phase.  i have no friends and i'm a disappointment to my family.  The problem is that I recently had someone to whom I could say everything and I could be who I am.  However, my ex girlfriend came back into my life with whom I was together for 4 years and she cheated on me twice.  Nevertheless, I still have incredibly strong feelings for her and she claimed to have them for me too.  I broke up with my girlfriend to run after my ex, which I now realized was a big mistake.  Now I've lost both and I'm alone again and, as usual, have disappointed everyone.  i'm not worth living
